data.name: Vampire One Blood
data.detailed_description:
Vampire One Blood is an FPS game that will reconcile you with difficulty and brutality. The premise is simple: mercilessly eliminate vampires using incredibly powerful weapons and fluid movements, which form the basis of this intense first-person shooter.

with a simple but captivating storyline. In this game, get ready to discover the beginnings of a story that began centuries ago and will see the emergence of an adversary who will disrupt the vampire order for decades to come.

During your fight, you will discover many weapons that will allow you to end their immortality with a good dose of violence. These supernatural beings will simply collapse before you.

Synopsis

During the battles, you will discover a diverse arsenal that will allow you to end their immortality in a frenzy of violence. These supernatural beings will crumble before your very eyes.

Vincent Moreau, an American cop of French descent, thought he had seen it all in his career. But when a series of unexplained disappearances shakes the city, his instincts scream that something is amiss. Yet, his superior orders him to drop the case, an order that sounds more like a warning than a directive. Far too stubborn to obey, Vincent decides to investigate alone. One night, he returns to the scene of the latest crime… and realizes too late that he should have listened. His elevator is sabotaged, and the trap closes around him. In the darkness, he faces his first vampire: a brutal fight from which he barely escapes alive. But now he knows. His world has just been turned upside down. Two choices lie before him: flee and find a way out… or plunge headfirst into the hell he has just discovered and exterminate every last one of these creatures hiding in the shadows. The night has only just begun.

data.short_description: Prepare for a perilous adventure! Vampire One Blood is a single-player, first-person shooter. A game that will make you appreciate a challenge. Face hordes of vampires in linear levels, armed with a variety of devastating weapons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia MSI GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
  • VR Support: not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-6600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia MSI GeForce RTX 4060 8GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
  • VR Support: not supported

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains violent scenes as well as blood and corpses, and should therefore be used with caution. Anyone who is sensitive to such content should take note of this detail.
